description: Custom metadata just past its documented 8 KiB on each write path: a PATCH that reaches exactly 8192 key and value bytes, a PATCH that only removes a key from an object at that size, a PATCH that merges one more key, and a multipart insert and an XML PUT of 8193 bytes. The 2026-11-15 live recording shows that Cloud Storage accepts every one of them; gcs-mimic keeps only its local 40 KiB bound on encoded metadata.

steps.name: multipart-past-limit
steps.body_text:
--gcsmimicdiff
Content-Type: application/json; charset=UTF-8

{{"name":"{object}-mp","metadata":{{"k":""}}}}
--gcsmimicdiff
Content-Type: text/plain

hello
--gcsmimicdiff--
